annotations.title: Show an invoice ready to send

description: Get one of the signed-in person’s invoices ready to email, with its PDF, to the client address on it from their business name. It opens a card showing exactly what the client will receive (who it goes to, the lines and the total) with a Send button. Nothing is emailed until the person presses Send on that card.
name: send_invoice
title: Show an invoice ready to send
